description: The keywords an app ranks for in App Store or Google Play search, each with monthly store search volume and the app's rank (United States, English). $0.02 a call plus $0.0002 a keyword.

app_id.description: The number in an App Store link (e.g. "964220645"), or with store "google" the package name (e.g. "org.telegram.messenger").

max_rank.description: Only keywords where the app ranks this high or higher.

name: app_keywords
